relation-6668806.summary: An early eleventh-century Chola temple and a component of UNESCO's Great Living Chola Temples. The illustration simplifies the stepped vimana and hall; it does not reproduce carved detail or a surveyed plan.

relation-6668806.height_basis: About 64.8 m reported by Thanjavur District; the model is an architectural approximation.

relation-8341173.summary: A palace complex with Nayak and Maratha building phases. Its halls and towers reflect multiple periods; a single construction date would conceal that history. The displayed courtyard arrangement is illustrative.

references.title: Thanjavur District · Palace history and photo gallery

relation-8345043.summary: The Darasuram temple is a twelfth-century component of UNESCO's Great Living Chola Temples. Its architectural detail is not captured by this generic stepped-tower illustration.

way-104683753.summary: The district administration attributes the ancient Grand Anicut to Karikala Chola. The extant irrigation works include later interventions; this attribution does not date every visible structure.

references.title: Thanjavur District · Grand Anicut history and photographs

way-592802648.summary: OSM records a gopuram near the Darasuram temple. Proximity does not independently establish its date or construction phase. The temple's UNESCO documentation provides regional context only.

references.title: UNESCO · Temple context, not a date for this gateway

node-3688301041.summary: A mapped memorial near Kallanai. The era of the ruler commemorated is not the date of this memorial. No independently matched architectural survey or construction date has been acquired.

node-11831919109.summary: An OSM memorial record south of Kumbakonam. It has not been equated with the similarly named Raja Rajan Mani Mandapam in Thanjavur city; that would be a different location. Construction date and geometry remain unverified.

node-12078431209.summary: A wayside-shrine record in the supplied OSM inventory. No independently matched period, architectural plan or subsurface investigation has been acquired. The pavilion illustration indicates a place type only.
